about.title: About
about.subtitle: Get to know me better
about.bio: I'm a self-taught developer from Peru who started coding in late 2024. Since then, I've been building projects in Python, JavaScript, and TypeScript, tackling algorithm challenges on LeetCode, and exploring web development with tools like Astro and Node.js. I believe in learning by doing — every project and every problem solved is a step forward.
